=== E1M2 === [[Lege Artis]] won

Teams had trouble getting this game played, [[Bored With Life]] apparently suggested to let [[Phantasy]], who wasn't registered as a player for LA, play with [[Lege Artis]] in this game and that the winner of their match would give the other walkover. After [[Slime]] posted screenshots from the match in the comments of matchreport on the NQR site which said Walkover quite some whine followed from people who thought that LA had been bending the rules, being able to play with someone who wasn't on their playerlist, and should be banned. == Links == * [[NQR Hall of fame|Nations Quake Rank Hall of fame]] * [[Nations Quake Rank]] == League Seasons == {{NQR Seasons}} [[Category:Matchreports]]
